# Growthbook <> RecargaPay - Intro/Enterprise Contract Discussion
Date: 2026-09-02 | Duration: 37.02000045776367m

## Summary
Recargapay is deciding whether to continue developing its internal experimentation platform or adopt GrowthBook’s self-hosted solution to centralize experiment and metric tracking. The evaluation reflects gaps in the current system, especially for metrics where users are randomized but offers or loans are measured. Red Magnos described repayment and conversion metrics that require beta-binomial analysis in Databricks notebooks because GrowthBook’s current ratio metrics, slicing, and statistical models may not provide sufficiently accurate confidence intervals. GrowthBook’s strengths include open-source extensibility, self-hosting, enterprise security, approval workflows, role-based access, SSO, data pipeline mode, dedicated engineering collaboration, and 24/7 support. Commercial discussions covered illustrative pricing of about $600–$750 per seat annually, a free tier limited to one project, and the need to finalize read-write and read-only users. Security documentation requires an NDA, while GrowthBook offered private Slack support, cost-comparison assistance, and Brazilian fintech references. A follow-up asynchronous session will address remaining technical questions.

## Keywords
Experimentation, self-hosted platform, data analytics, metric breakdowns, fintech compliance, open source extensibility

## Action Items

Set up a private Slack channel with GrowthBook’s data scientists and engineering team to support RecargaPay’s asynchronous technical discussions (30:43)
Share GrowthBook’s trust center security documentation and coordinate NDA process with RecargaPay to address fintech regulatory compliance needs (32:07)
Await detailed seat count and access requirements from RecargaPay to build a tailored pricing proposal for GrowthBook’s enterprise offering (31:19)
Provide cost/benefit analysis comparing internal build versus adopting GrowthBook to assist RecargaPay’s decision-making process (34:38)
Follow up on connecting RecargaPay with GrowthBook’s contact at Stone, a Brazilian fintech customer, for peer reference and insights (34:59)
